notes.title: Lux Delux 6.6 update
notes.content: Lux Delux version 6.6 is now available on steam. This update increases the font size when viewing maps very large. It also eliminates a bug some users were having downloading the list of extra maps. Enjoy!

notes.title: Lux Delux adds Chinese and Korean language translations
notes.content:
Lux Delux 6.56 update is now available for downloading. This update includes translations into Chinese and Korean languages.

Full Changelog:
- Added translations into Chinese (Simplified and Tranditional) and Korean.
- The /map command now works regardless of capital/lowercase cases.
- Better behaviour when winner-picks mode is on with no map list is set.
- Network hosts will auto-restart crashed games after 3 hours of inactivity.
- Better hooks for network clients to end team-games when only 1 team remains.
- Added translation kit link to language selection.
- Windows: update the included private JRE to 8_111.
- Linux: set the temp folder inside the launch script, for wider steam compatibility.
- Windows (Steam): included a TEST executable that sets the temp folder.

If you're on Windows and get an launch error, try running the "Lux Delux TEST" executable that's beside the normal one in the Steam-Lux install location.

notes.title: Lux Delux updates
notes.content:
Lux Delux has been updated to version 6.55. Changes include:

- A link to your personalized ranking webpage is now included on the Network Game listing.

- The expansion games (American History Lux and Ancient Empires Lux) will now run correctly on all systems (linux included). 

- A few other small changes are also included :)

notes.title: Update for Linux and overlay compatibility
notes.content:
We just updated Lux Delux to fix an issue that some Linux users were reported, with the game not starting properly.

This update also furthers our work on making Lux Delux work better with the Steam overlay on Windows computers. Please let us know how the overlay is working for you with this update.

Cheers!
